subject: Ranef not giving values for all sites

messages.author: d5ae607f2255e054
messages.subject: Ranef not giving values for all sites
parts:
Hello all,

I am trying to retrieve site abundance estimates for a multinomial poisson model multinomPois() with removal sampling. However, only a portion of sites are actually given estimates when I call ranef(). The rest of the sites are given 0 for the mean and mode and NA for the confidence intervals. My data consists of 3-8 survey events per site. The 3-survey sites did not capture anything and the rest have either 6 or 8 surveys. The only sites given estimates using ranef() are the sites with all 8 surveys. I have tested this model by removing the extra 2 survey events of the 8-survey sites and ranef() will give me estimates for all sites (minus the 3-survey sites - but we assume them zero anyways). It seems to be the missing survey data that is causing the problem. 

Here is one of the 6-survey sites as an example of how its coded. I am also using 2 survey covariates and there are values corresponding with every survey and NAs where a survey did not. 

                                                   
Survey Event    1       2       3       4       5       6       7       8
Site  Counts     8       5       3       3       2       0     NA    NA

What perplexes me is that this model (and a more complicated version with abundance covariates) runs without error. I am able to predict out the model results and graph them. I can run the Nmix.gof.test() on the model just fine. It seems to just be ranef() that does not work completely. It doesn't give an error just the warning "Some observations have been discarded because corresponding covariates were missing." 

Please let me know if there is a solution.

Thank you,

Jena

messages.subject: Re: is marginal effect the same as the coefficient?
parts:
Hello all,

I just did an analysis using Royle Nichols model ( occupancy data to get abundance estimate) in unmarked package. Also got the estimate from ubms. 

i am trying to get marginal effects of predictors. i don't understand marginal effect in this content, can I calculate marginal effect here? or is it just the standardized cofficient?? i didn't calculate unstandardized coefficient as my units of measurement are different for predictors. 

can you please tell how I can get marginal effect for a data in umf framework? i am using occuRN function in R. 

Actually, it's my thesis and I have the comment that I also calculate marginal effect and unstandardized coefficient but I have never seen anything like that in any literature.

Can you shade some light?

Thank you so much. 

Regards,
Bina
